name: Pakapow Party
description:
About This Game

1-4 Players | Spin the Wheel & Battle Bosses | Team Up or Sabotage Friends!

Pakapow Party is an online board game for 1–4 players, where you’ll go on an adventure to protect villages from invading monsters, seize resources, and explore strange, unpredictable stories.

You could end up becoming an ultrarich tycoon but beware, your teammates might just turn you into a poor wanderer! Are you ready to team up with friends and take on fearsome bosses in Pakapow Party?

Game Features:

  • Spin the spinner and set off on your adventure.

  • Encounter monsters and fantastical story events that await you.

  • Hunt down the evil bosses out to challenge brave heroes.

  • Enjoy vibrant, charming visuals paired with elegant, dynamic action!
